reader.requirement: At --std 85 a report-name written in the REPORT clauses of two file description entries must be refused, and each report-name of a legal one-clause REPORT IS / REPORTS ARE list (one or several reports on one file) is accepted.
reader.edition-search: Read ScreenReportClauseNames whole and the ReportNames collection in BindFileSection; neither reads DialectLevel, CobolVersion, Constructs. or ReservedWords (Edition is only the diagnostic sink).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1285-report-in-two-clauses (refused at 85) covers two FDs with one name each; a name inside a multi-name REPORTS ARE list, a repeat inside one clause and the legal shared-file form are covered by these probes

probes.printed: EXIT 65; error COBOL2714: file 'RPT2': the REPORT clause names 'R-A', which is already named by the REPORT clause of file 'RPT'
probes.expected: refused: R-A in two REPORT clauses

probes.printed: EXIT 65; error COBOL2714 for 'R-A' repeated in one REPORTS ARE clause
probes.expected: refused (degenerate: GR1 reads two names as two reports, and only one RD R-A can exist)

probes.printed: EXIT 0; A / B; P6A.RPT holds 'A' and 'B' lines
probes.expected: accepted: REPORTS ARE R-B R-A on one file, order not significant

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.3.3 SR2  (3.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2
OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.3 SR1  (3.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:XIII.3.3.4 GR1  (3.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: ScreenReportClauseNames walks every FD's REPORT names in order and refuses each name already claimed by an earlier clause, the same code at every edition. A repeat inside one clause is also refused; the 1985 SR2 wording does not literally forbid it, but XIII.3.3.4 GR1 makes each listed name a distinct report and XIII.3.5.3 SR1 gives each report one RD, so no legal 1985 program is refused.

refuter.evidence: Read ReportSectionBinder.cs#ScreenReportClauseNames (per program's _d.State.Files.Declared and _scope.Declared). The edition-specific attack is the nested program (1985 Inter-Program Communication level 2): E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-076/r6a_nested_same_name.cob (OUTER FD RPT REPORT IS R-A with RD R-A; nested INNER FD RPT2 REPORT IS R-A with its own RD R-A) -> EXIT 0, OUTER DONE / INNER DONE: the rule is not over-applied across programs, matching §1985:XIII.3.3.3 SR1's 'Report Section of the same program'. cite.py: OK  §1985:XIII.3.3.3 SR2  (3.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2; OK  §1985:XIII.3.3.3 SR1  (3.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1.
